pagerduty-bot: URGENT: Elevated error budget burn and spike in 5xx for org=phoenix-run (org-4521). Auto-page to oncall. Severity: P1.

emma (oncall): Got the page, joining. Quick snapshot?

jon (sre): QPS up ~3.6x last 6m. Errors: ratelimit_rejected + 502 upstream. Traffic shows many short-lived connections from 12 distinct IPs across 3 regions. Looks like a credential leak + fanout.

rachel (eng): They're primarily hitting model redwood-llm-64k which has async KV warmups. That plus concurrent long contexts is stressing backend.

emma (oncall): Can we do per-key burst caps without fully throttling the org? Need to protect infra and keep the customer's core users up.

ops-bot: Suggested mitigations: org soft cap, per-key burst limits, route long-context to smaller model, or temporary denylist of compromised tokens.

jon (sre): Preference: apply per-key burst limits + dynamic deprioritization for tokens over threshold. Steps I recommend: 1) set per-key burst to 5rps sustained 20rps burst 2) enable traffic-shaper deprioritize for keys with >1000 concurrent tokens 3) reserve headroom for other orgs.

rachel (eng): Commands (runbook traffic-control-v3):
```
# set per-key burst window for org-4521
infractl quota set --org=org-4521 --per_key_burst=20 --sustained_rps=5 --window=60s --reason="emergency-leak-2113"

# enable deprioritization rule for heavy-context
infractl shaper set --org=org-4521 --rule="input_tokens>2500 => deprioritize=1" --mode=canary --duration=120s

# optional: denylist compromised tokens (fingerprints)
infractl auth blacklist add --org=org-4521 --token-fp="fp:a9c3..." --token-fp="fp:b7f2..." --reason="confirmed-leak"
```

emma (oncall): Applying per-key burst canary now (60s). Will watch error rates and other org impact.

pagerduty-bot: Command executed by emma (oncall): `infractl quota set ...` 1s ago.

jon (sre): After 30s: overall 5xxs down 34% for phoenix-run traffic. Some of the customer's long-running bulk jobs still hitting high latency, but success rate improving. No cross-org spillover.

deep (support): Reached out to Phoenix Run contact. They confirm a cron job leaked dev credentials; rotating keys now. Asking if we can do a "soft prioritize" so their paying customers still get throughput.

emma (oncall): We can lift some measures if they rotate. Proposal: keep per-key burst caps, remove deprioritize canary if rotation completes and tokens validated. Also add transient limit on model redwood-llm-64k for that org: allow max 30 concurrent sessions.

rachel (eng): Command to cap concurrent sessions for heavy model:
```
infractl model cap --org=org-4521 --model=redwood-llm-64k --concurrency=30 --mode=soft --duration=2h --reason="protect-cluster-after-leak"
```

ops-bot: Note: consider fallback routing to redwood-llm-16k-quant for sessions that exceed concurrency to avoid outright failures.

jon (sre): Adding fallback rule now, threshold 60s latency fallback to medium model.
```
infractl fallback set --org=org-4521 --threshold=0.9s --fallback-model=redwood-llm-16k-quant
```

emma (oncall): Fallback applied.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2113 created by emma (oncall). Runbook=traffic-mitigation-v3. Severity=P1.

deep (support): Phoenix Run says rotation complete at 2113457045. They've provided new token fingerprints and IP allowlist.

tala (acct-manag): They're asking for timeline to remove restrictions; they'd like per-key quotas normalized for verified tokens.

jon (sre): Verify new tokens and host IPs for 2m, then escalate removal. Steps: 1) validate token fingerprints in auth logs 2) confirm traffic pattern stable 3) remove deprioritization and increase concurrency cap.

emma (oncall): I'm verifying now. Found new token fprints present and traffic originating from expected CIDRs for last 4m.

emma (oncall): Removing shaper canary and raising concurrency cap to 80. Executing: `infractl shaper remove --org=org-4521 --rule="input_tokens>2500 => deprioritize=1"` then
```
infractl model cap update --org=org-4521 --model=redwood-llm-64k --concurrency=80 --mode=soft
```

pagerduty-bot: Commands executed by emma (oncall).

jon (sre): Monitoring 20m window. Early signs good. 5xxs remain near baseline, p95 latency improved 22% vs peak. No other org impact.

emma (oncall): Handing off monitoring to jon for next 40m. I'll log incident ticket with mitigation notes and create follow-ups: tighter per-key burst defaults, automated leaked-token detection, and customer guidance template.

deep (support): I'll follow up with Phoenix Run for postmortem and to confirm they want formal SLA credits.

tala (acct-manag): I'll join postmortem with billing context.

emma (oncall): Closing active mitigations in thread. If anything regresses, reopen. Thanks team. :pray:

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2113 moved to MONITORING. Mitigations recorded: per-key burst canary, deprioritization rule, concurrency cap, fallback routing, token blacklist.
